question: Related Questions Q. What do Ulama say about the following masail? Please answer these masail in the light of Qur?an and Sunnah of the Prophet (saw) that one can pay the sum of Zakat to this sort of organization or not. Now my Question is CAN I SPEND those money for my Poor patient of HANAFI Or other mushlim.... and If i can use it hoe to Spend so that I dont get Involved in dealing personally.......as I am afrais of ALLAH too much as far as MONEY and INcome is concerned...!!! 2112 views Q. mufti sab assalamalaikum..we own commercial buildings and get a monthly rent of about rs 7 lacs pm..since the land and building is given out for rent only and not sale..i would like to know if i have to pay zakat on the rent recieved by me..specially when the entire rent is being consumed by me and my family and not saved for one whole year ..thank you .. 2375 views
answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 47121 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: ZAKAT Question: Mrs. A owned a building but then she transferred it in the name of her daughter B. However, still Mrs. A is receiving the rent. Who is responsible to pay zakah Mrs. A or her daughter B? Answer ID: 47121 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1187/917/H=10/1434) The daughter did not become owner merely by transferring the name. Mrs. A shall remain its owner until it is not given into complete possession of daughter B. It is right for Mrs A to receive the rent and she shall also pay zakah on the rent (if applicable). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
